# `core-agents`

Research agent that creates citation-driven academic papers, comprehensive reports, and evidence-based analyses, and answers follow-up questions about completed research.

## Prerequisites

- The [GitHub Copilot CLI](https://github.com/github/copilot-cli) (or Agency) with this marketplace added (see **Install** below).

The `researcher` agent pairs well with the `research-methodology` skill from the `core-skills` plugin.

## Install

Add the marketplace once, then install this plugin:

```bash
copilot plugin marketplace add Menny1337/copilot-plugins
copilot plugin install core-agents@copilot-plugins
```

Update later with `copilot plugin update core-agents@copilot-plugins` (or `plugins-update` to refresh everything). See the [repository README](../../README.md) for per-session Agency profiles, aliases, and global-install options.
